meta.title: Fix AI chat query execution to only run when chat pane is open
meta.body_summary: Guard AI chat query execution behind the chat pane open state to prevent unnecessary API calls when the AI assistant is closed.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added query guard with hasFetchedOnce, which maintainers questioned; after removal, a maintainer asked to roll back and PR was closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1722 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change, but 1538 lines are in package-lock.json. The core logic changes are only ~18 lines in the hook plus test additions. As a performance fix, it was closed despite modest scale due to design pushback from maintainers.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer cezudas initially requested lint fixes and comment removal. Another maintainer alexandrudanpop questioned the `!hasFetchedOnce.current` guard as overly restrictive. cezudas suggested using `staleTime: Infinity` instead. After Copilot removed `hasFetchedOnce`, cezudas then asked to roll back the entire commit. The PR was closed without merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate unnecessary API calls when AI chat pane is closed by gating the query on `isAiChatOpened`.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_io (unnecessary API calls when chat not open)
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer cezudas commented 'Can you roll back the previous commit?' and the PR was closed shortly after without further commits.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot struggled to find a solution that satisfied maintainer expectations. The initial `hasFetchedOnce` guard was deemed too restrictive; after its removal, a maintainer requested a full rollback, indicating a failure to align on the desired approach.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers reviewed the diff and raised concerns about the `hasFetchedOnce` logic during inline reviews, questioning its impact on reopening chats and suggesting alternative strategies.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after metrics or benchmark; only narrative claims of eliminating unnecessary calls.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the final commit removing `hasFetchedOnce`, maintainer cezudas asked to roll back that commit. The PR was closed without further changes.

core_change_summary.description: In ai-assistant-chat-hook.ts, added useAppStore to read isAiChatOpened and set enabled: isAiChatOpened on the useQuery that opens the AI chat, preventing the API call when the chat pane is closed. Initially included a hasFetchedOnce ref guard which was later removed after review.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Dependency updates in package-lock.json and package.json (1538 lines) appear unrelated to the performance fix and may be carry-over from a merge or install step.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added enabled: isAiChatOpened guard and hasFetchedOnce ref to prevent repeated executions.
After lint/comment cleanup and maintainer pushback, removed hasFetchedOnce to allow reopening chats.
Maintainer then requested to roll back the last commit; PR closed without further action.

review_signals.summary: Requested to fix lint errors and remove code comments.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot fixed lint and removed comments.

review_signals.summary: Questioned the need for !hasFetchedOnce.current; suggested using staleTime: Infinity instead.
Asked why !hasFetchedOnce.current is needed and whether it would block opening other chats.
Acknowledged the issue and removed hasFetchedOnce in a follow-up commit.
After the hasFetchedOnce removal, asked 'Can you roll back the previous commit?'
SonarCloud quality gate passed with no new issues.
Confirmed that lint errors were fixed and code comments removed.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial query guard including hasFetchedOnce.
cezudas requested lint fixes and comment removal; Copilot applied them.
alexandrudanpop and cezudas raised design concerns about hasFetchedOnce in inline reviews.
Copilot removed hasFetchedOnce, but then cezudas asked to roll back the entire commit.
PR closed ~3.3 hours after creation with no merge.
